blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Estate Water, a Non-East Zone operating unit of Manila Water, is expanding its portfolio of innovative water solutions through the investment and operation of a seawater desalination facility at Ayala Land’s Lio Tourism Estate in Palawan. The initiative reinforces its capability to deliver a reliable and sustainable water supply even in areas with limited freshwater resources while strengthening water security amid the growing impacts of El Niño and other climate-related challenges. The project reflects Estate Water’s ability to develop advanced treatment technologies tailored to the specific water requirements of the communities and developments it serves.
